posts.title: Harbour seal spotted using the ferry ramp as a sunbed
posts.body: Commuters on the 07:40 ferry were delayed by four minutes on Monday while a seal, nicknamed Bertil by locals, declined to move. Harbour staff said the seal was 'not on the timetable, but welcome'.

posts.title: Bakery introduces cinnamon bun with a queue number
posts.body: After a record 62-person line on Saturday morning, Kanel & Co. has started handing out numbered tickets. Owner Maja Lindqvist says the buns themselves are unchanged.

posts.title: Town council votes to paint the bike lane blue
posts.body: The vote passed 7 to 4 after a long debate about which shade of blue. The council settled on 'harbour blue', with work expected to start in October if the weather allows.

posts.title: Library reports surge in borrowed board games
posts.body: The library has lent out more board games than novels for the first time. Staff are now looking for volunteers to check that all the dice are still there.
